meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 vercel 命令行把 web 应用部署到 Vercel（生产或预览），并发你一个可访问的线上地址；它先在本地跑构建、确认部署状态和 URL 返回 2xx 才报给你。也能管理项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、发布 web 应用，或管理 Vercel 的项目、域名等资源时，它会接管。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: 先本地构建，成功后才给出线上地址

say.text: 把 Vercel 上的环境变量拉到本地 .env
say.note: 通过 vercel env pull 拉取

say.text: 给当前项目加上 example.com 这个域名
say.note: 通过 vercel domains add 添加

howto.what_en: Claude uses the vercel CLI to deploy web apps to Vercel (production or preview) and give you a live URL, after running the local build and checking the deployment status and URL response. It also handles projects, domains, and env vars.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web app, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, and env vars.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
say_en.note: Runs the local build first, then returns the live URL.

say_en.text: Pull the Vercel env vars into a local .env
say_en.note: Uses vercel env pull to fetch them.

say_en.text: Add example.com as a domain to this project
say_en.note: Adds it via vercel domains add.
